learner: Bayesian logistic regression, diagonal Laplace posterior, prior N(0,1), per-row updates; act by Thompson sampling (scripts/policy/learn.py)

arms.what: the recommendation registry's dimensions: which off-mode craft axis is listed first

values.label: on-screen words in the first 2 s
spoken words in the first 2 s

arms.source: data/generated/model/winning-modes.json axes; rendered by src/components/video-reads.tsx Recommendations

context: the video's percentile on each off-mode axis

reward.primary: the creator acts on the advice: their next original within 30 days moves that axis at least 10 percentile points toward the winning mode's center on its craft read

logging.store: pax2-ledger usage log (src/lib/usage.ts); the next original's craft read joins by owner

kindToAdd.rec-shown: subject = video id, meta = {order: [axis...], propensities, registryVersion}
kindToAdd.rec-acted: written by the scorer when a later original by the same owner moves a shown axis: subject = new video id, meta = {axis, from, to, shownOn}

logging.propensity: probability of each axis's position under the sampled ordering

epochMarker.rule: No replay; every update is a live decision logged as above.

evaluation: Once 1,000 logged decisions exist: the standard protocol of docs/briefs/WINDOW-P2.md with the logged propensities in place of estimated ones (IPS is then unbiased), registered in the brief before the first fit.
